# What FIPS 203, 204, and 205 Specify

In August 2024, the Secretary of Commerce approved FIPS 203, FIPS 204, and FIPS 205—standards designed to resist future quantum attacks. Together, they cover two functions: establishing a shared secret and creating digital signatures.

FIPS 203 specifies a method for communicating parties to establish a shared secret over a public channel. FIPS 204 and FIPS 205 both specify digital signature schemes. FIPS 204 uses a module-lattice-based approach, while FIPS 205 specifies a stateless hash-based approach.
